title: Switching trace weight bound
statement: Let $n,w,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates whose width is at most $w$, and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. Sum the weights, at parameter $\delta$, of the target restrictions associated to the switching traces chosen for each restriction on which the restricted formula has decision-tree depth at least $k+1$. This sum is at most the number of switching codes of width parameter $w$ and length $k+1$.
